summary: Presents a referral code and link, delegating copy-to-clipboard to the consumer.
whenToUse: Showing referral details and requesting a copy action from the consumer.
whenNotToUse: To share content, use ShareButtons when sending or copying is desired.

props.name: referralUrl
props.description: Referral URL displayed as a link.

props.name: onCopyRequest
props.description: Request callback: the copying itself is up to the consumer.

keyboard.action: Reaches the link and the copy request button.

accessibility: Code and URL have visible terms in a description list.
responsive: Long URLs wrap without widening the card.
customization: Colors, borders and spacing use --dc-* tokens.
commonMistakes: Assuming the button copies directly or tracks the action.
limits: The actual copying is implemented by the consumer.
